note:
Independently hand-checked classification for 319 FC2 releases listed under fc2cmadb.com/tags/\u30a2\u30ca\u30eb on 2026-10-03. Each row was read from its own detail page and judged by the rules below, WITHOUT running this repository's code against it - that is what makes it a check on the parser rather than a snapshot of the parser.

  removed   the detail page no longer exists
  censored  the detail page carries the censorship badge
  no playable duration (an image set or an unplayable record)
           the 'length' slot holds an IMAGE COUNT rather than a length (two rows: 4940877
           at 60 images and 4715577 at 161 images). fc2cmadb carries image sets beside
           videos, so such a record can never match an upload's length, and is excluded
           rather than retried for ever.
  accepted  uncensored, with a duration
  null      NOT READ - the site answered HTTP 429 before the walk reached this record. A null row is not evidence of anything; it is here so the walk's incompleteness is measurable.
